id.description: Unique identifier of the alert action rule.

createTimestamp.description: Time at which the alert action rule was created.

name.description: Name to let humans easily identify and understand the alert action rule.

notes.description: Large text field that allows users to leave notes for themselves and others.

enabled.description: If set to true, this rule is active, if set to false, it will not be applied.

alertTypes.description: If defined, this rule will only trigger on alerts of the given types.

actorIds.description: If defined, this rule will only trigger on alerts about actors with the given ids.

actorTypes.description: If defined, this rule will only trigger on alerts about actors of the given types.

actorAccountIds.description: If defined, this rule will only trigger on alerts about actors from the given accounts.

ruleIds.description:
If defined, this rule will only trigger on alerts that were generated by one of the given alert condition
rules.

priority__gte.description: If defined, this rule will only trigger on alerts with a priority greater than or equal to the given value.

priority__lte.description: If defined, this rule will only trigger on alerts with a priority less than or equal to the given value.

alertActionIds.description: Defines the actions to take if an alert matches the rule.

locationIds.description: If defined, this rule will only trigger on alerts about actors from the given locations.

imageOptions.description: Image attachment configuration for this rule. When null, the existing single-image behaviour is used unchanged. When set, all actions linked to this rule will receive images resolved from alert.data URLs (images are resolved from alert.data URLs). Maximum 6 images total per execution. Currently applied to SMTP and Immix actions.

AlertImageConfig.description: Configuration for the primary alert image. Always included when imageOptions is set; cannot be disabled.

embeddedOverlay.description: Use the overlay-embedded full-frame image. Falls back to the plain full-frame image if the overlay version is unavailable in alert.data.

includeCropUrl.description: Also attach the cropped detection-region image. Silently skipped if the crop URL is not present in alert.data.

ContextImageItem.description: Configuration for one context image at a specific second offset from the event timestamp.

offsetSeconds.description: Seconds relative to the event timestamp. Negative values are before the event, positive values are after. 0 is excluded — that is the alert image itself (configured in alertImage). Valid range: -5 to +5 excluding 0.

imageType.description: Image type. Only "full" is supported currently.

ImageOptions.description: Image attachment configuration for an alert action rule. Defines which images are attached when the rule fires. Maximum 6 images total per execution: 1 alert image + 1 optional crop + up to 4 context images.

contextImages.description: Ordered list of additional context images. Each item specifies one image at an explicit second offset from the event timestamp. Offsets must be unique; 0 is excluded (that is the alert image itself).
